bio: This small restaurant with a family atmosphere is to be found on a quiet square slightly set back from the Plage de Ciboure. In this seaside resort, a couple (chef and pastry chef) work in tandem to concoct mouth-watering market cuisine. The Spanish chef proposes a lunch menu (changed every two to three days) or a short à la carte menu (renewed every two months) that highlight seasonal produce: bonito, leche de tigre and sweet potato crisps; hake steak, sriracha sauce and piquillos stuffed with pig's trotters. In the evenings, there is a tasting menu in addition to the à la carte menu....
